thread.title: WSJ: Apple in talks to give military vets access to electronic medical records - Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL)

author: Carl Surran
title: WSJ: Apple in talks to give military vets access to electronic medical records - Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL)
text:
Apple (NASDAQ: AAPL ) is in talks with the Department of Veterans Affairs to provide portable electronic health records to military veterans , which would simplify hospital visits for patients and allow the company to tap millions of new customers, WSJ reports.
AAPL would create special software tools allowing the VA’s ~9M veterans currently enrolled in the system to transfer their health records to iPhones and provide engineering support to the agency, according to the report.
The partnership would be a major boost for AAPL as technology companies look for ways to enter the $3.2T health care market.
